goal: Operator-locked P0: maximize artifact-backed useful-work duty cycle. Normal nonterminal turns target at least 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds); ACTUAL END + 2 minutes (120 seconds) is the active continuation canary, not a requirement for exact provider dispatch.

active_interventions.expected_effect: Prevent voluntary normal CONTINUE close before 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds).
Determine whether +120 seconds improves continuation/authority safety enough to justify one extra nominal idle minute versus +60 seconds.
Accept harmless early/late scheduler jitter immediately when single authority can be preserved; fence only real overlap/stale-authority hazards.
Separate execution evidence from host UI delivery; never infer work from trace visibility or trace delivery from work evidence.

latest_runtime_interpretation.epoch_91: First active +120-second canary successor sample arrived 146 seconds late and remained eligible.
latest_runtime_interpretation.epoch_92: Second +120-second successor sample arrived 121 seconds early; timing mismatch alone was not fenced and no authority conflict was observed.
latest_runtime_interpretation.epoch_93: Third +120-second successor sample arrived 46 seconds late; all three direct +120 successor samples have continued without observed duplicate authority. Timing-accuracy superiority over +60 remains unproven.

dominant_risks: No three-consecutive P0-A sustained-turn gate exists yet.
The +120-second canary adds one nominal idle minute versus +60 seconds, so it must earn that cost through better continuation or authority safety.
Provider execution jitter remains bidirectional and distinct from local schedule mutation correctness.
Host UI may not surface intermediate progress messages; durable trace capture plus final flush remains required.
next_decision: Keep +120 seconds only if continued live evidence shows a net continuation/authority-safety benefit that outweighs its extra nominal idle minute. Otherwise revise or roll back toward +60. Continue >=600-second substantive turns and measure total non-useful gap, not scheduler timing error alone.
